I'm 14 and been carrying heavy things since I was 10 — court dates, loud arguments, things no child should see. I stayed quiet and tried to be good so things wouldn't get worse. My hands shake when I'm stressed, but they still create, still hold on. Crochet became my therapy — I make beauty with so little, and that's how I heal. At home I do more than my share to keep peace and protect the ones I love, even when I'm tired, even when my hands hurt. I jump at sudden sounds and zone out — my body's been on guard too long. But I'm growing, glowing up, and learning my comfort matters too. I passed my exams, finished my bag, and I'm still standing. I'm not broken — I'm just a girl who survived too much too young, and I'm blooming anyway. 🌸💛
